newsitem.title: USA: AltaVista says surprised by Digital suit.
newsitem.headline: AltaVista says surprised by Digital suit.

text.p: AltaVista Technology Inc said it was surpised by the lawsuit filed against it by Digital Equipment Corp, describing as "unsubstantiated and completely without merit" its charges of trademark infringement.
The company said in a statement it had reached a licensing agreement with Digital in March outlining the terms for the legal use of the "AltaVista" trademark by both companies.
The company, which designs Internet computer software, said it had the rights to the name and trademark for three years before Digital gave the same name to its new search engine software.
Digital filed its suit last week, saying it had bought the trademark from the company and then licensed very limited and specific uses of it back to it.
